Daily Devotional

January 21

24 Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them. (Mark 11:24 KJV)

Some people have taken this verse out of context and tried to apply it to just anything that they want. You can only receive from God, those things that He has provided for us, His children, by His grace, and if He didn’t already provide it for us by grace, then this verse does not apply. You can’t just pray for what ever you want, but only for those things that God has already provided (James 4:3). This verse taken out of context has caused some to think they can murder, rob and do all kinds of evil, and get away with it, but the Grace of God does not provide those things to us. Our prayers must be in accordance with the will of God.

It is a powerful truth that you must believe you receive, when you pray, before you will receive what you are wanting. You must have the faith necessary to believe that you receive before you pray, and not after you receive the answer, as faith is what pleases God (Hebrews 11:6). So many people just pray, and don’t really believe that God will answer their prayer, and that just voids the prayer. You must exhibit the faith when you pray to get your prayers answered. Also you must not have a lot of unbelief in your heart as that will void your faith (Matthew 17:20). Thank you Father for hearing our prayers and promising to give us our answers, when we pray according to your will (Matthew 21:22).
